## Writing

Technical guides on DeFi mechanics, written for practitioners.

- Building with Claude as a PM — https://sarthak-guleria.github.io/sarthak-guleria/writing/building-with-claude-as-a-pm.html
  Building MVPs collapsed from weeks to days. The workflow, the four words you have to know first, and a worked example so the abstract gets concrete.

- What the Heck is Liquidity? — https://sarthak-guleria.github.io/sarthak-guleria/writing/what-the-heck-is-liquidity.html
  From TradFi dark pools to Uniswap math: liquidity, AMMs, impermanent loss, and LP mechanics explained fully.

- Delta Neutral on Hyperliquid — https://sarthak-guleria.github.io/sarthak-guleria/writing/hyperliquid-delta-neutral.html
  Practical guide to basis trading and earning funding rates on Hyperliquid across ETH, BTC, SOL, XRP and top markets.

- A Practical Guide to Yield Looping on Aave on Mantle — https://sarthak-guleria.github.io/sarthak-guleria/writing/aave-loop-guide.html
  How to use sUSDe, GHO, and Aave E-Mode to amplify yield through looping, with full risk analysis and stress test.
